paragraphs: Reporter Helen interviewed the team before the city museum opened its new gallery. Curator Nora began with a regular routine: {{red:“I work at the museum every weekend.”}} {{mask_1}} She described the current project: {{red:“We are preparing a new exhibit this month.”}} {{mask_2}} Then she shared some completed work: {{red:“I have finished the visitor guide.”}} {{mask_3}} Technician Leo explained what happened the previous day: {{red:“I saw the director yesterday.”}} {{mask_4}} The director described next week’s plan: {{red:“We will open the east gallery next Friday.”}} {{mask_5}} Nora also explained a current arrangement: {{red:“I am meeting the school group tomorrow.”}} {{mask_6}}

Helen asked Nora about the visitors and the collection. Her first question was: {{red:“Did the school group enjoy the workshop?”}} {{mask_7}} She followed up with: {{red:“Where do you keep the original paintings?”}} {{mask_8}} Then she asked: {{red:“Can visitors take photographs in this gallery?”}} {{mask_9}} A volunteer made a request of Leo: {{red:“Please print twenty copies of the guide.”}} {{mask_10}} The security guard gave visitors an instruction: {{red:“Do not block the emergency exit.”}} {{mask_11}} Nora asked two assistants: {{red:“Could you move these boxes upstairs?”}} {{mask_12}}

Before the interview ended, Leo responded to a concern about a damaged frame: {{red:“I am sorry I damaged the frame.”}} {{mask_13}} He also answered a question about a missing key: {{red:“I did not take the missing key.”}} {{mask_14}} The conservator gave the team some advice: {{red:“You should label the boxes before storing them.”}} {{mask_15}} Helen reviewed her notes, making sure the report included the team’s updates, questions, requests, and explanations.
